player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Forneca exatamente UMA ação entre parênteses, p.ex. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', ou '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ka ci tava [check] - ⁠oku imba ocela cosande.
invalid_move.amount_min: Oku imba ocela cosande ci sukila oku kuata esilivilo lialua.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Ka kuli lacimue ci ku tateka; o pondola oku [check] vilikiya.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Use [bet X] to open; there is no bet to raise.
invalid_move.insufficient: Momo ka va kuatele olombongo vioku landa ovina viaco.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: both {card}. Pot split – each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Oku kuata olo chip via lisoka kesulilo liohongele yaco, ci nena onima yiwa.
